items.name: Scope matches the spec
items.note: Relocation of the ack plus its reader/writer and the docs naming it. No unrelated behaviour.

items.name: No duplicated hazard left behind
items.note: _read_legacy still used `git show {commit}:{path}` after I removed that exact MAX_PATH spelling from _read_committed one function above, so the legacy leg would have failed on precisely the deep checkouts the new leg was fixed for. Refactored _read_legacy to read through _read_committed, removing the duplicate and giving it the same absent-vs-broken discrimination.

items.name: Behaviour added while answering review is itself tested
items.note: The `source` return value and the appended worktree/legacy caveat were added in response to the Stage-1 review and initially shipped with no test and no ledger row, while the ledger still claimed 21/21 completeness. Added ledger rows 22-24 and assertions in the three tests that traverse each source, including the negative case so a caveat that fires unconditionally is also caught.

items.name: Error paths fail closed
items.note: git failure is an error, not an absence; present-but-invalid is terminal and never falls through to the legacy leg; unsafe run id fails closed but only after the no-CI-file early exit.

items.name: Tests assert behaviour, not implementation
items.note: Round-trip drives the real CLI into a real commit through the real verifier; that depth is what surfaced the MAX_PATH defect. The F6 drift guard was mutation-checked after the reviewer showed the first version could not fail.

items.name: No weakening of an existing gate
items.note: DERIVED_SNAPSHOTS untouched and pinned by test; run/fingerprint/field validation unchanged; unsafe-run-id branch strictly strengthens. The one property that did move (durability) is stated in the spec rather than claimed away.

items.name: Affected boundaries covered
items.note: Artifact write->commit->read seam covered by the round-trip test; F6 staging verified to be directory-level and pinned by a mutation-checked drift test; F11 verifier surface covered by the composition tests.

items.name: Conventions followed
items.note: All touched files under the 300-line rule; ruff clean; append-log discipline kept for conventions.md (superseded marker, not a rewrite).
